name: servicenow-mcp-ai
description: Drive ServiceNow from VS Code Copilot Chat — 101 tools over the full REST surface, with plan-and-apply write safety, capability preflight and an ACL security scan.

servicenowMcp.envFile.markdownDescription: Env file the server reads and writes (`SN_ENV_FILE`). Supports `~`, `${userHome}` and `${workspaceFolder}`; a relative path resolves against the first workspace folder. Empty = the server default (`~/.config/servicenow-mcp-ai/.env`). A **Sign In** stored in SecretStorage takes precedence over the file's values. Changing it re-registers the server definition.

enumDescriptions: Profile: table, schema, aggregate — read-first, no scripting tools.
Profile: reader + scripts, flows, codecheck, docs.
Table API: query, get, create, update, upsert, delete records.
Script intelligence: search code, where-used, trace, lint.
Local code checks and code health.
Self-documentation store, instance / table / app documents, diagrams.

servicenowMcp.packages.markdownDescription: Tool packages or profiles to register (`SN_TOOL_PACKAGES`). Empty = the server default (`core`). Use **ServiceNow MCP: Choose Tool Packages** to pick them. Changing it re-registers the server definition.

enumDescriptions: The server runs as a child process of VS Code over stdio (default).
The extension launches the server with SN_TRANSPORT=http on a free loopback port with a random per-launch bearer token, and VS Code connects over Streamable HTTP.
servicenowMcp.transport.markdownDescription: How VS Code talks to the server. `stdio` is the default and recommended; `http` runs the server's Streamable HTTP transport on `127.0.0.1` only. Changing it re-registers the server definition.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with ServiceNow MCP
walkthroughs.description: Sign in to an instance, pick the tool packages, check the connection and ask Copilot Chat a first question.

steps.title: Sign in to your instance
steps.description:
Store the instance and a secret in VS Code SecretStorage — never in settings or on disk.
[Sign In](command:servicenowMcp.signIn)

steps.title: Pick the tool packages
steps.description:
Start with the default core set; add scripts, flows or docs when you need them.
[Choose Tool Packages](command:servicenowMcp.selectPackages)

steps.title: Run the doctor
steps.description:
Check credentials, connectivity and what your user can read. The verdict also shows in the status bar.
[Run Doctor](command:servicenowMcp.runDoctor)

steps.title: Try a first prompt
steps.description:
Open Copilot Chat in agent mode with a ready-made read-only question.
[Try a First Prompt](command:servicenowMcp.tryFirstPrompt)

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the workspace values of servicenowMcp.envFile, servicenowMcp.packages and servicenowMcp.transport are ignored.
